title: Ammonia cracking benchmark harness
objective: Rank benchmark ammonia-decomposition catalysts with live metal feeds, transparent procurement anchors, and route-confidence weighting.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Balance economics, source confidence, route confidence, and performance.

cost-first.label: Cost-first
cost-first.description: Bias ranking toward selling cost while keeping route and evidence guardrails.

evidence-first.label: Evidence-first
evidence-first.description: Reward transparent, higher-confidence pricing and more reproducible routes.

citations.label: Cleaner Energy Systems 2026
citations.note: Economic analysis summary comparing Ru, Ni, and Co ammonia-decomposition catalysts under matched conditions.

citations.label: Nature Communications 2023
citations.note: Ru ensembles on MgO(111) reported as a high-activity ammonia-decomposition architecture.

citations.label: PubMed 2025
citations.note: Ni_xMg_1-xO/CeO2 interface catalyst highlighted for efficient ammonia decomposition without noble metal loading.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 203874
citations.note: Nickel nitrate hexahydrate procurement anchor with public pack-size pricing.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 206229
citations.note: Ruthenium chloride hydrate procurement anchor with public pack-size pricing.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 63107
citations.note: Magnesium oxide reagent pricing used as a transparent support-price anchor, not a direct industrial support basis.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 211575
citations.note: Cerium oxide public catalog price used as a promoter/support procurement anchor.

citations.label: Sigma-Aldrich 202606
citations.note: Alumina public catalog price used as a transparency anchor while screening cost uses an engineering support proxy.

catalog_quotes.note: Public reagent price used as a procurement sanity check; CatPrice still tracks Ni on a live metal basis for screening.
Transparent reagent price anchor for Ru precursor procurement.
Public support anchor; bulk industrial support pricing is screened separately to avoid lab-pack distortion.
Transparent promoter/support anchor for ceria-containing routes.
Public alumina catalog price used as a transparency anchor; screening support cost remains an engineering proxy.

route_templates.name: Wet impregnation on oxide support
synthesis: Slurry mixing or incipient wetness loading
route_templates.route_note: Most transferable route for industrial catalyst screening and the easiest baseline to scale.

route_templates.name: Interface-engineered Ni-MgO-CeO2 route
route_templates.route_note: Improves performance without noble metal loading, but route discipline and support engineering are less mature.

route_templates.name: Ru dispersion on basic oxide
synthesis: Low-volume deposition with tight Ru balance
route_templates.route_note: Premium low-temperature route with the clearest activity upside but the highest sensitivity to Ru pricing.

candidates.title: Ni/gamma-Al2O3 baseline
candidates.summary: Non-noble industrial baseline for current-price screening.
decision_notes: Tracks Ni live price directly, so economics move with a broadly traded industrial metal.
Lowest route complexity and easiest basis to defend in desktop screening.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with nitrate-style precursor markup.
Industrial support screening proxy retained to avoid lab-pack alumina distortion.

candidates.title: Ni-MgO/CeO2 interface
candidates.summary: Ni route that aims to recover activity through support/interface engineering instead of noble metal loading.
decision_notes: Still avoids Ru, but the route adds ceria handling and tighter support engineering.
Useful when you want better low-temperature activity without moving to a noble-metal basis.

pricing.note: Live Ni feed with precursor markup.
Ceria promoter priced with a conservative engineering proxy; Sigma quote retained as a procurement anchor.
MgO support uses a screening proxy rather than reagent-pack pricing.

candidates.title: Ru/MgO premium
candidates.summary: High-activity Ru route for low-temperature ammonia cracking when activity is worth a noble-metal premium.
decision_notes: Performance leader at low temperature, but economics are dominated by Ru exposure.
Best fit when reactor temperature or start-up intensity matters more than catalyst replacement cost.

pricing.note: Ru feed tracked on the live/reference metal board with precursor markup.
Support cost kept on an engineering basis even though a public Sigma quote is attached for transparency.
